anti_metrics: training or test recall of primitive truth-table rows is NOT unseen understanding
classifying equivalent ASTs without executing valid predictions is NOT composed behavior
a constant yes/no predictor is rejected using both semantic labels
a syntactic match or raw string equality is NOT general semantic equivalence
searching more candidates or caching prior solutions is NOT verified capability gain
a small parameter count or 0 seconds due to no execution is NOT an efficiency improvement
meaning-channel gradients/rotation are causal pathway evidence, not a universal scalar measure of understanding
source RLT checkpoint contains multiplication training; reuse is not zero-shot discovery

retention.denominators: old_skill_cases > 0; every prior verified skill separately and every stage
retention.gate: zero regression on exactly proven prior scope; otherwise report lost cases and no promotion
retention.qualifier: old skill must have frozen pre-stage independent receipt with scope and checkpoint

search_learning_efficiency.dominance: A dominates B only if A passes all semantic/retention gates, is no worse on all reported capability scores/cost metrics, and strictly better on at least one
search_learning_efficiency.formula: distinct_verified_new_families / total_wall_seconds, with numerator and denominator separately reported
search_learning_efficiency.missing_energy: null and labelled NOT_MEASURED; never treat missing as zero
search_learning_efficiency.priority: Never optimize cost by skipping execution, semantic checks, verification or training while calling results equal
search_learning_efficiency.total_cost_identity: training + inference + proposal + search + verification wall-component times may overlap; total_elapsed is independently timed, do not sum overlapping times

semantic_equivalence.denominators: TP+FN > 0 AND TN+FP > 0, otherwise invalid score
semantic_equivalence.inputs: typed candidate classification of positive and negative AST pairs, same width/signedness
semantic_equivalence.negative: one exact typed counterexample under same semantics
semantic_equivalence.nonexecution: invalid; count as incorrect on that case, no abstention bonus
semantic_equivalence.positive: ground-truth equivalent under declared bitvector semantics
semantic_equivalence.require: record TP,TN,FP,FN, per-family numerators, proof scopes, counterexamples

unseen_composition.denominators: registered_heldout_cases > 0; report by family, width, sign and seed
unseen_composition.nonexecution: 0 correct; timeout, missing output or type mismatch counts as failed case
unseen_composition.not_allowed: training-seen primitive truth rows cannot count as unseen composition
unseen_composition.split: structurally held-out entire formula families, no access during training/model selection

verified_capability_gain.baseline: freeze code, checkpoint, family list and proof scope before training
verified_capability_gain.metric: newly certified distinct operators or rewrite families, not examples or cached programs
verified_capability_gain.proof: each gain needs typed contract, exact checkpoint/source hash, independent proof or explicit finite-exhaustive scope, counterexample search, non-regression
verified_capability_gain.rejected: memorizing exact programs, source ROM reuse, self-reported discovery, sampled agreement labeled proof

model_and_rom_limit: NC019 defines evaluation, does not establish learned program generation or fuse host ROM with Transformer
optimization: hard-gated lexicographic correctness/verified transfer first; Pareto efficiency among passing models only
precedence_rule: NC-019 semantic-first research correctness, unseen verified transfer and retention dominate NC-018 compute-minimization; NC-018 is retained as an execution-cost subproblem and its original task/ledger remains untouched.
promotion_hard_gates: semantic equivalence evaluation with nonempty TP+FN and TN+FP and all negative controls disclosed
no false equivalence accepted in independently certified exhaustive/proof scope
at least one structurally unseen test family independently checked before calling transfer
all previously independently qualified operations retained at their original proof scopes
new capability credited only when nontrivial new family is absent from frozen baseline and certified independently
all training/inference/proposal/search/verification compute and memory costs recorded, no hidden oracle/host substitution
three matched seeds reported individually with seed-specific failure cases; do not hide regressions in averages
independent actual verifier identity, exact source/checkpoint hashes and rollback plan required
reversible champion promotion only after downstream dedicated release task; NC019 itself never promotes
scalar_meaning_score: NONE; unrelated measured dimensions remain separate
